purpose.zh: 活动髋部，练习往后坐时背保持平直
purpose.en: Loosen your hips and practice keeping your back flat as you sit back.

text.zh: 背保持平直，屁股往脚跟方向坐
text.en: Keep your back flat and rock your hips back toward your heels
Keep your hands planted and your arms straight.

text.zh: 背快要弯的时候就停住，再往前回。
text.en: Stop just before your back starts to round, then rock forward.

commonErrors.en: Rounding the back as you rock back.

cautions.zh: 髋部不舒服时幅度小一点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your hip feels uncomfortable, move less far, and stop if it still hurts.

cautions.zh: 手腕刺痛或发麻时停止，开始前先活动手腕
cautions.en: Stop if your wrists feel sharp pain or numbness, and warm them up first.

changes: 名字和主口令去掉「中立/Neutral」术语，改「跪撑平背后坐 / Hands-and-Knees Rock Back」
用户已定：改名、计时/计次、每侧/起始侧、计数单位按最终口径处理，相关待定项清除
最终口径：按真实做法定（2026-11-01）
